core_coverage.answer_quote: Karma is a mage and support who pokes enemies with magic damage and helps allies with shields and movement speed.
core_coverage.reason: Explains her roles, poke, shielding and movement speed, but omits the frozen core's slows.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Mantra empowers her next basic ability, changing its effect, while damaging abilities help bring Mantra back.

issues: Add slowing enemies to the overview to cover its complete frozen role mechanic.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Mantra empowers Karma's next basic ability with an additional effect.
core_coverage.reason: Correctly explains that Mantra modifies the next basic ability.

core_coverage.answer_quote: She begins with it available at level 1 without spending a skill point, and its empowered effects scale with its rank.
core_coverage.reason: Explains early availability, no skill-point cost and rank dependence.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Damaging abilities that hit enemy champions reduce Mantra's current cooldown.
core_coverage.reason: Includes the enemy-champion hit condition and current-cooldown effect.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Inner Flame fires a directional bolt that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies and briefly slowing them.
core_coverage.reason: Explains direction, first-hit collision, splash damage and slow.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Soulflare empowers Inner Flame with increased damage and a larger bolt that also explodes at maximum range.
core_coverage.reason: Explains all three empowered projectile changes.

core_coverage.answer_quote: The explosion creates a slowing field that later ruptures for magic damage.
core_coverage.reason: Explains the lingering slow and delayed damage.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Focused Resolve damages and tethers a target enemy champion, monster, or pet, revealing them while the tether holds.
core_coverage.reason: Explains eligible targets, initial damage, tether and reveal.

core_coverage.answer_quote: If the tether is not broken by its end, it deals magic damage again and roots the target while continuing to reveal them.
core_coverage.reason: Explains the completion condition, further damage, root and continued reveal.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Renewal empowers Focused Resolve with a longer root and heals Karma when cast.
Renewal empowers Focused Resolve with a longer root and heals Karma when cast. It heals her again if the tether lasts its full duration or the target dies while tethered.
core_coverage.reason: Explains both healing triggers but omits that healing is based on missing health.

issues: Specify that Renewal heals based on Karma's missing health; this explains its low-health reversal purpose.
The counterplay correctly limits its prevention claim to the completion-triggered heal.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Inspire shields Karma or a targeted allied champion and briefly grants bonus movement speed.
core_coverage.reason: Explains target eligibility, shielding and temporary movement speed.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Defiance empowers Inspire with a stronger shield on its primary target and spreads reduced-power shields and movement speed to nearby allied champions.
core_coverage.reason: Explains the stronger primary shield and reduced-power group protection and speed.

conflicts.resolution: Keep recovery qualitative. The draft does not promote conflicting numerical change notes into current mechanics.
Keep the supported qualitative increased-damage description; do not treat the trailing change note as an established current value.

factual_risks: Mantra's sourced eight-second empowerment window is omitted; the answer does not teach that an unused empowerment expires.
Advanced spell-shield and crowd-control interactions are reasonably deferred. Bug, unexpected-behavior and historical change notes are not promoted into card facts.
The external pedagogical metadata adequately types Counterplay and broad AP orientation; no duplicate card-face labels are needed.
omitted_topics: Renewal's missing-health-based healing, an important frozen core mechanic and explanation of its low-health purpose.
Slows in the frozen overview role mechanic; slowing effects are covered on the individual Q cards.
